buzzRounds.topic: Ovechkin says this is his last season
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Alex Ovechkin, the NHL's all-time leading goal scorer, announced on Monday, October 5 that the 2026-27 season will be his last. He is 41, in his 22nd season, and has 929 career goals and 1,688 points in 1,575 games, all with the Washington Capitals.
buzzRounds.whyCare: It turns every Capitals game into a farewell. Ovechkin also holds the career records for power-play goals (331) and game-winning goals (141), and his 20 goals in home openers tie Mike Gartner for the most ever. His last home opener is Wednesday night against Sidney Crosby's Pittsburgh Penguins.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Ovechkin just announced this is his final season. He's 41 with 929 goals, the most in NHL history, and his last home opener is tonight against Crosby and the Penguins.

details.name: Alex Ovechkin
details.buzz: Ovechkin said on October 5 that 2026-27 is his final NHL season. He has 929 career goals, first all-time.

buzzRounds.topic: No. 1 pick McKenna scores; Matthews wins it in overtime
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Gavin McKenna, the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft, scored his first NHL goal and added an assist as the Toronto Maple Leafs came back from 3-0 down to beat the Nashville Predators 5-4 in overtime on Tuesday. Auston Matthews had four points (1 goal, 3 assists), including the winner with 14 seconds left in overtime.
buzzRounds.whyCare: McKenna had gone three games without a point, and Toronto (2-2-0) has had all four of its games decided by one goal.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Gavin McKenna, this year's No. 1 draft pick, scored his first NHL goal Tuesday, and Matthews won it for Toronto 5-4 with 14 seconds left in overtime after they'd been down 3-0.

buzzRounds.topic: Lafreniere hat trick as Rangers beat the Islanders
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Alexis Lafreniere scored a hat trick, meaning three goals by one player, and added an assist as the New York Rangers beat the New York Islanders 5-2 on Tuesday. Two of his goals went into an empty net in the last two minutes.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The Rangers are 4-1-0 with four straight wins and 3-0-0 at home for the first time since 2009-10. Their goalie Igor Shesterkin even scored a goal on October 1, the first ever by a Rangers goalie.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Lafreniere had a hat trick in the Rangers' 5-2 win over the Islanders on Tuesday. That's four straight wins, and they're 3-0 at home to start a season for the first time since 2009.

details.name: Alexis Lafreniere
details.buzz: Lafreniere's four-point night, with three goals, came in the Rangers' fourth straight win.

buzzRounds.topic: Panthers lose Marchand to an injury, Barkov out 6-8 weeks
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Brad Marchand was helped off the ice holding his left knee late in the second period of the Florida Panthers' 2-1 win at the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday, after a high stick from Kings defenseman Brandt Clarke. The team called it an apparent lower-body injury with no timetable. Captain Aleksander Barkov is already out 6 to 8 weeks with a lower-body injury from October 1; he won't need surgery.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Barkov captained Florida to back-to-back Stanley Cups in 2024 and 2025, and now two of its biggest names are hurt in the first week. Matthew Tkachuk scored the winner in LA, and Florida is 2-0-2.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Florida's had a rough first week: Barkov is out 6 to 8 weeks, and Marchand got helped off the ice holding his knee in Tuesday's 2-1 win in LA.
